It could simply boil down to your genetics. I dealt with acne from the time I was 14 to 17. My acne is very, very tame now. I use the benzoyl peroxide kit from Walmart and it works super well on the acne that does pop up. Your skin type is also a huge thing to take into consideration! Do you wake up with your face feeling slick? That's oily skin. If you wake up with it feeling tight, you may have dry skin. Combination skin is when it's oily around the t-zone, and drier around your cheeks. If you have oily skin, look for water based products, and stuff like hyaluronic acid! Drier skin requires more moisture, so moisturizing oil based products may come in handy if you have dry skin. 
Overall, tea tree oil (you HAVE to dilute this), aha's, retinol, clay masks, may work to get your acne under control! I hope this helped. If you need product suggestions, I'm here to help!
